prompt: A checkbox mutes a counting button by unregistering its listener. Complete setMuted and isMuted using addActionListener/removeActionListener, without ever registering the same listener twice.
explanation: Listeners are not a fixed part of a component -- they can be attached and detached at any time with addActionListener and removeActionListener. Removing the counting listener makes the button inert without changing the button itself, and getActionListeners().length reports how many are currently attached. The guard in setMuted(false) matters because addActionListener happily registers the same object twice, which would fire it twice per click.
hints: removeActionListener takes the very same listener object you passed to addActionListener -- that is why counterListener is stored in a field.
bump.getActionListeners() returns an array of the listeners attached right now; its length tells you whether the counter is still connected.
In setMuted(false), only call addActionListener when isMuted() is true, otherwise a second unmute would attach the listener a second time.
